تفتكرين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَكِرِينَ (taftakirīna) /taf.ta.ki.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# تُفْتَكَرِينَ (tuftakarīna) /tuf.ta.ka.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
